headline: The mountain learned to manual
lede: SSX's missing signature — the ground-combo glue the 2000 original defined itself by — is live: land a trick with the edge held and let go clean for chain-scaled points, nose-up.

notes.text: SSX manuals shipped (#3905): a paid landing with ↓ held rolls into a nose-up manual; releasing clean pays 150 x held-seconds x your chain multiplier (meter fed at the trick rate), capped so Showoff stays honest. Ollie, crest, lip and rail exits pay on the way out — butter off a roller and the combo lives.

Other lanes shipped all around it this cycle: SSX far-peak fidelity (#3902), the Lemmings look slice with sloped planks and splintering wood (#3904), Comet Drift's clean attract column (#3906) and SimCity-Min's one-stroke language (#3907).

ssxmodelcheck's touch-pad selectors fail on this Mac at origin/main too (CI green) — the #3108 full-pad default outranks the old trick-row queries. Named, not blamed: a harness issue to file if it recurs.
New gates: ssxcheck 348 to 363 — entry, capped pay, chain scaling, crash forfeit, butter exits, hash ride, and a cold-planner guard so the witness lines stay byte-identical. Hand-mutant proven.

look.text: Land a trick, hold ↓, release — MANUAL.
